mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.0% indicates a deteriorating labor market, which triggers investor concerns about economic weakness and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a contraction in consumer demand, which depresses corporate earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 0.5% from the prior month, the S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals an early recession and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO is below 100, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals rising price pressures that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a slowdown in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST declines by more than 0.5% and GDPC1 growth rate declines by more than 0.5% from the prior period, the S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of low inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
